notes.title: Recent Developer update. Shaders, Object Import, Volumetric fog
notes.notes:
Over the last month more has been added to the game.

Improved the fluid shader to greatly enhance the lava look.

Added the ability to import 3d objects of various formats.

Added adjustable volumetric ground fog that affects lights, shadows and othe FX.
